# Guest guide QR encoder

`qrcode-generator-1.4.4.mjs` is the JavaScript encoder from the MIT-licensed `qrcode-generator` npm package, pinned at 1.4.4. Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator. Retrieved from https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz on October 23, 2026.

The only source change is the final ESM export. Copyright and license notices remain in the file. The full MIT terms are included in [qrcode-generator-LICENSE](qrcode-generator-LICENSE). The guide uses the encoder locally to draw a Wi-Fi QR code after private access is verified. Credentials never go to a QR generation service. No dependency installation or third-party runtime request is required.
